name: Mages
blurb: Mages is an experimental Matrix chat client built with Compose Multiplatform and a Rust core powered by matrix-rust-sdk.
description:
Mages is an experimental Matrix chat client built with Compose Multiplatform
and a Rust core powered by matrix-rust-sdk. The flatpak currently shows 2 tray
icons and the tray menu doesn't follow the system theme (legacy lib).

Features include:

• Room list with previews and unread counts

• Room and thread timelines (text, media, polls)

• End-to-end encryption via matrix-sdk

• Spaces browser

• Presence and privacy settings

Note: This is experimental software. Things may break, but encryption
is handled by the battle-tested matrix-rust-sdk.
